description: Wishbone DMA control status and the four-word transfer used by this scenario.
notes: The RTL control readback concatenates (dma_state != DMA_IDLE) and cfg_err as bits 31 and 30: third_party/soc-zipcpu/rtl/peripherals/wbdmac.v, o_swb_data case 00.
The source contract independently describes status_busy_mask 0x80000000 and status_error_mask 0x40000000 in src/myfuzz/local_harness/wbdmac_source_contract.py.
block_words specifies this scenario's transfer size, not the device's maximum transfer capacity; it does not claim that the busy or error bits were asserted by a run.
